brief.title: AI换脸：用途、风险与谨慎使用
brief.hook: AI换脸不只是一个有趣的效果——同一种技术，为什么既能帮助教学，也可能给人带来现实麻烦？
key_points: 展示AI换脸的基本概念与示例对象
用正反对照解释技术的用途与风险
用证据卡和风险链路替代装饰性素材
以谨慎使用作为明确结论
brief.core_message: 技术本身有两面性，使用方式决定结果，因此AI换脸必须谨慎使用。
brief.cta: 谨慎使用AI换脸，并在分享前考虑可能造成的后果。
brief.tone: 可信、克制、分析型，案例段提高视觉密度
brief.style: clean-professional定制：炭黑、白、亮黄；底部粗体字幕、黄白重点字、证据卡、硬切
brief.target_audience: 对AI换脸感兴趣的普通观众与内容创作者
brief.selected_angle: 证据驱动的技术两面性

decisions.subject: Production pipeline

options_considered.label: Hybrid
options_considered.reason: Preserves the supplied talking-head as anchor while adding designed evidence layers.

options_considered.label: Talking Head
options_considered.reason: Fits the source but its beta pipeline is less explicit about full-screen support scenes.
options_considered.rejected_because: The requested reference treatment relies on evidence cards and mixed support layers.

options_considered.label: Animation
options_considered.reason: Would displace the authentic source speaker.

decisions.reason: The requested treatment is source-led with purposeful support visuals.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime

options_considered.label: Remotion
options_considered.reason: Best fit for frame-accurate source video, subtitle timing, and React overlays in one pass.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames
options_considered.rejected_because: More complex than needed for a 45-second source-led edit and less aligned with the existing caption timeline.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg
options_considered.reason: Reliable for encoding and simple overlays.
options_considered.rejected_because: Insufficiently expressive for the requested animated editorial hierarchy.

decisions.reason: It preserves source synchronization while supporting the reference-style typography and evidence cards.

decisions.subject: Composition authoring mode

options_considered.label: Customized template
options_considered.reason: Extends the stable presenter composition with a new editorial overlay system.

options_considered.label: Atelier
options_considered.rejected_because: The brief asks for an existing reference grammar and the low-resolution source benefits from restrained customization.

decisions.reason: A controlled extension gives the requested look without unnecessary production risk.

decisions.subject: Background music

options_considered.label: No music
options_considered.reason: Keeps the non-native English speech maximally intelligible and matches the restrained reference.

options_considered.label: Pixabay royalty-free music
options_considered.rejected_because: Adds little value to this short cautionary explainer.

decisions.reason: Speech clarity is the audio priority.

decisions.subject: Human approval gates

options_considered.reason: The user explicitly requested that no questions be asked throughout.
